summary: Frontend regression after 80-Jahre Jubiläum / Recht & Regeln / no-stock-photo refactor. All 12 routes, navigation, mobile menu, Recht page, contact-form integration, Caveat font load and /images/logo.jpg validated successfully. Backend /api/contact verified working via real submission (200 + persistence response).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx: NAV array correctly removed 'Feste'; 'Recht & Regeln' label slugifies via custom slug() to 'recht-und-regeln' (matches data-testid contract). No drift between desktop and mobile NAV.
App.js: /feste route fully removed; catch-all '*' -> NotFound handles legacy URLs correctly (verified – /feste shows 404 page).
Recht.jsx: BKleingG, Garten- und Bauordnung, Schottergärten, Hecken, Bienen, Bodenuntersuchungen sections all present. Verband external link uses rel='noopener noreferrer' (security best practice).
index.html / index.css: Caveat font is loaded and the .font-script utility resolves to it (document.fonts.check('16px Caveat') === true).
Logo image /images/logo.jpg loads (naturalWidth > 0) in both navbar and footer.
Contact form: data-testids follow `contact-input-{name}` pattern (vorname, nachname, email, telefon, nachricht, datenschutz) and `contact-submit-button` – consistent and testable.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ contact submissions created via POST /api/contact during E2E verification (TEST/User, test_user@example.com). Backend has no delete endpoint exposed; main agent may want to purge via DB if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All review requirements verified: (1) Home shows 1946-2026 jubilee + '80 Jahre' text + Caveat font + jubilaeum CTA, (2) desktop & mobile NAV contain 'Recht & Regeln' (testid nav-link-recht-und-regeln / mobile-nav-link-recht-und-regeln) and no 'Feste' link, (3) /feste shows NotFound, (4) /recht renders with recht-page testid + all required content sections + recht-verband-link, (5) all 12 routes (/, /wir-ueber-uns, /vorstand, /aktuelles, /recht, /galerie, /anfahrt, /kontakt, /vereinsheim, /winterdienst, /impressum, /datenschutz) load without NotFound, (6) Logo /images/logo.jpg loads, (7) Contact form submits successfully (POST /api/contact → 200, success toast 'Nachricht gesendet – wir melden uns bald!', form resets), (8) No console errors/pageerrors captured on any tested page. NOTE for future testers: contact-submit must be clicked WITHOUT force=True after scrolling into view – force-click can bypass the form submit event in this setup.
rca of the issue: No issues found in this iteration.
